title: Forgetting available coordinates
statement: For a finite set $A$ of available coordinates and a decision tree indexed by $A$ whose internal nodes query coordinates in $A$ and remove each queried coordinate from the indices of both children, define an ordinary sign-valued decision tree by retaining each leaf value and each query and recursively converting its two children.
